records.jp: これだけベッドが広いと……夢が膨らむね
records.en_original: A bed like this really makes you dream big...
records.en: A bed like this really makes you dream big...

records.jp: 夢？
records.en_original: Dream big?
records.en: Dream big?

records.jp: みんなで集まって、パジャマパーティー！<CR>してみたくならない？
records.en_original: Yeah, like what if we had a pajama party with everyone?
records.en: Yeah, like what if we had a pajama party with everyone?

records.jp: わー、いいねいいね！
records.en_original: Ooh, I like where this is going!
records.en: Ooh, I like where this is going!

records.jp: ルームウェアをみんなでお揃いにしたら<CR>すっごく盛り上がりそう！
records.en_original: We should all wear matching pajamas!
records.en: We should all wear matching pajamas!

records.jp: 写真たくさん撮りたいね！
records.en_original: We have to take a ton of pictures!
records.en: We have to take a ton of pictures!

records.jp: あ、変なきぐるみを着るのも面白そう
records.en_original: Oh, we could even get some weird costume pajamas!
records.en: Oh, we could even get some weird costume pajamas!

records.jp: 例えばどんな？
records.en_original: Like what?
records.en: Like what?

records.jp: うーん、焼きそばパン型とか
records.en_original: Hmm... Like a yakisoba bread onesie!
records.en: Hmm... Like a yakisoba bread onesie!

records.jp: そんなのあるの！？
records.en_original: Does that even exist?!
records.en: Does that even exist?!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんはどんなのがいい？
records.en_original: What kind would you want, Ao?
records.en: What kind would you want, Ao?

records.jp: 私はもこもこの可愛いやつ着たいなー。<CR>でも今は夏だし、ちょっと暑いか
records.en_original: I think I'd want a cute fluffy one. But it's the middle of summer, so it might get a little hot.
records.en: I think I'd want a cute fluffy one. But it's the middle of summer, so it might get a little hot.

records.jp: 夜中にみんなで山盛りのから揚げを食べたい！
records.en_original: I wanna chow down on a mountain of fried chicken in the middle of the night with everyone!
records.en: I wanna chow down on a mountain of fried chicken in the middle of the night with everyone!

records.jp: えっ？　なんでから揚げ？
records.en_original: Huh? Why fried chicken?
records.en: Huh? Why fried chicken?

records.jp: それはね……愛央さんの大好物だからで～す！
records.en_original: Because it's my favorite!
records.en: Because it's my favorite!

records.jp: そうだったんだ！　から揚げ、おいしいよね
records.en_original: Really? I didn't know that! I love fried chicken too!
records.en: Really? I didn't know that! I love fried chicken too!

records.jp: でも、レモンをかけるかけないで派閥がありそう
records.en_original: But then there's the great debate of lemon versus no lemon.
records.en: But then there's the great debate of lemon versus no lemon.

records.jp: はうっ……！<CR>パジャマパーティーが一瞬にして戦場に……？
records.en_original: Oh no... The pajama party might turn into a war zone...
records.en: Oh no... The pajama party might turn into a war zone...

records.jp: か、から揚げ以外にもいろいろ揃えておこっか！<CR>可愛いお菓子とか、謎味ジュース詰め合わせとか
records.en_original: W-we can get other food besides fried chicken! Like cute little cakes, and maybe a mystery punch?
records.en: W-we can get other food besides fried chicken! Like cute little cakes, and maybe a mystery punch?

records.jp: 可愛いお菓子！　絶対必要！
records.en_original: Cute little cakes! We gotta have those!
records.en: Cute little cakes! We gotta have those!

records.jp: 謎味ジュースは？
records.en_original: What about the mystery punch?
records.en: What about the mystery punch?

records.jp: そっちは要検討
records.en_original: Let's come back to that later.
records.en: Let's come back to that later.

records.jp: だめかー
records.en_original: I guess that's a no...
records.en: I guess that's a no...

records.jp: ショッピングモールがあればね。<CR>いろいろ見て回って、ぴったりなのを探せたけど
records.en_original: If only there was a mall here... We could go and pick out all the right stuff.
records.en: If only there was a mall here... We could go and pick out all the right stuff.

records.jp: もう随分ぶらぶらお買い物とかしてないなぁ。<CR>元の世界に戻れたら、みんなでお出かけ……
records.en_original: I haven't gone shopping in forever. We should all go when we get back to our world...
records.en: I haven't gone shopping in forever. We should all go when we get back to our world...

records.jp: ……。<CR>できたら、よかったんだけど……
records.en_original: ...If only...
records.en: ...If only...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん？
records.en_original: Ao?
records.en: Ao?

records.jp: あー……えっと。<CR>今は浮かれてる状況じゃなかったなーと
records.en_original: Uhh...let's see. Sorry, I lost the vibe for a second.
records.en: Uhh...let's see. Sorry, I lost the vibe for a second.

records.jp: いつか、本当にできるといいなあとは思うけど
records.en_original: I just really hope we'll be able to do that someday.
records.en: I just really hope we'll be able to do that someday.

records.jp: できるよ！　絶対！
records.en_original: We will! I know we will!
records.en: We will! I know we will!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori...

records.jp: 問題を全部解決して、みんなで楽しく遊ぶの！<CR>一緒にがんばろ、愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: After we fix all our problems, we'll all hang out! Let's do it together, Ao!
records.en: After we fix all our problems, we'll all hang out! Let's do it together, Ao!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんはすごいなぁ
records.en_original: You're amazing, Hiori.
records.en: You're amazing, Hiori.

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: いつも前を向いてて、諦めなくて……。<CR>うん。漫画のヒロインみたい
records.en_original: You're always so positive, never giving up... You're like the heroine of a manga.
records.en: You're always so positive, never giving up... You're like the heroine of a manga.

records.jp: そ、そんなことないよ！
records.en_original: Th-that's not true!
records.en: Th-that's not true!

records.jp: みんながいてくれるから、<CR>大丈夫って信じてるだけなんだ
records.en_original: I just know that everything will work out if we stick together.
records.en: I just know that everything will work out if we stick together.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんも、そう思わない？<CR>頼もしい仲間がいっぱいいるから平気だーって
records.en_original: All you need is some friends you can count on, don't you think?
records.en: All you need is some friends you can count on, don't you think?

records.jp: ……うん。確かに陽桜莉さんの言う通りかも！
records.en_original: Yeah... You might be right, Hiori!
records.en: Yeah... You might be right, Hiori!

records.jp: ……ありがとう、陽桜莉さん。<CR>少し気持ち軽くなった
records.en_original: ...Thanks, Hiori. I feel a little better now.
records.en: ...Thanks, Hiori. I feel a little better now.

records.jp: 本当？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: うん。また明日からもがんばれそう
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's keep giving it our best tomorrow!
records.en: Yeah. Let's keep giving it our best tomorrow!

records.jp: 今日、そばに陽桜莉さんがいてくれてよかった
records.en_original: I'm so glad you were here with me today, Hiori.
records.en: I'm so glad you were here with me today, Hiori.

records.jp: そ、そうかな？　えへへ……
records.en_original: R-really? Ehehe...
records.en: R-really? Ehehe...

records.jp: ……でも……うーーん……
records.en_original: But... Hmm...
records.en: But... Hmm...

records.jp: わ、なになに？　近いよ、陽桜莉さん
records.en_original: Whoa, what is it? You're really close, Hiori!
records.en: Whoa, what is it? You're really close, Hiori!

records.jp: 少しはいつもの愛央ちゃんに戻ったけど……<CR>まだ元気が足りないなぁ
records.en_original: The Ao I know is back...but you still seem a little tired.
records.en: The Ao I know is back...but you still seem a little tired.

records.jp: そういうときは……これに限る！
records.en_original: In that case... There's only one thing to do!
records.en: In that case... There's only one thing to do!

records.jp: ね～んね～んころり～よ～♪
records.en_original: Rock-a-bye baby, on the treetop...
records.en: Rock-a-bye baby, on the treetop...

records.jp: （寝るに限るってことか……）
records.en_original: (The only thing to do is sleep...?)
records.en: (The only thing to do is sleep...?)

records.jp: （いい夢見れそう……）
records.en_original: (This'll give me some nice dreams...)
records.en: (This'll give me some nice dreams...)

records.jp: ……愛央ちゃん？
……眠った、みたいだね
records.en_original: Looks like you're asleep...
records.en: Looks like you're asleep...

records.jp: いつもいろいろ頑張ってくれてありがとう、<CR>愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Thanks for always working so hard, Ao.
records.en: Thanks for always working so hard, Ao.

records.jp: 頑張ってるからこそ、自信が持てなくなったり、<CR>不安になったりするんだと思うんだ
records.en_original: If you ever start to lose confidence, or feel insecure...
records.en: If you ever start to lose confidence, or feel insecure...

records.jp: そういう時は……私がいるってこと、<CR>思い出してくれると嬉しいなぁ
records.en_original: ...Just remember that I'm here for you.
records.en: ...Just remember that I'm here for you.

records.jp: おやすみ……ゆっくり休んでね
records.en_original: Goodnight... Sweet dreams.
records.en: Goodnight... Sweet dreams.

records.jp: （寝たふりしてみよう）
records.en_original: (I'll just pretend to be asleep.)
records.en: (I'll just pretend to be asleep.)

records.jp: すー……すー……
records.en_original: Zzz... Zzz...
records.en: Zzz... Zzz...

records.jp: ……愛央ちゃん、寝ちゃったかな？
records.en_original: ...Ao? Are you asleep?
records.en: ...Ao? Are you asleep?

records.jp: ふあぁ……<CR>なんだか私も……眠たくなってきちゃっ……
records.en_original: Phew... I'm pretty sleepy myself...
records.en: Phew... I'm pretty sleepy myself...

records.jp: ……陽桜莉さん？
records.en_original: Hiori...?
records.en: Hiori...?

records.jp: （陽桜莉さんの方が先に寝ちゃったみたい）
records.en_original: (Looks like she fell asleep before me.)
records.en: (Looks like she fell asleep before me.)

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、さっきは励ましてくれて<CR>本当にありがとうね
records.en_original: Hiori, thanks for encouraging me earlier. I really appreciate it.
records.en: Hiori, thanks for encouraging me earlier. I really appreciate it.

records.jp: あ、あとちょっとだけ<CR>甘えさせてもらっちゃおうかな
records.en_original: M-maybe I'll stay here just a little longer.
records.en: M-maybe I'll stay here just a little longer.

records.jp: （……くっついたら起きちゃうかな？<CR>でも、陽桜莉さんの腕、あったかいな）
records.en_original: (Will she wake up if I snuggle up next to her? Her arms are so warm...)
records.en: (Will she wake up if I snuggle up next to her? Her arms are so warm...)

records.jp: （私も本当に眠くなってきたかも……）
records.en_original: (I must be sleepier than I thought...)
records.en: (I must be sleepier than I thought...)

records.jp: むにゃ……？<CR>……しまった、うっかり眠っちゃって……
records.en_original: Mm...? Ngh, I must have fallen asleep...
records.en: Mm...? Ngh, I must have fallen asleep...

records.jp: ……！？<CR>これは……どういう状況……！？
records.en_original: ...?! What's happening right now...?!
records.en: ...?! What's happening right now...?!
